test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘EXIT’ is written as ‘FJYU’ and ‘HIDE’ is written as ‘IEJF’. How will ‘GAME’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘EXIT’ is written as ‘FJYU’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87928c592243d3091d08cd886afaa69fa4110d144b923e8b590bd56d5f7e3074.png] 

‘HIDE’ is written as ‘IEJF’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d849536bd869410e647dde99a0cbeb35031d5747e670c760ce42c3d4d12d92e8.png] 

Similarly, 'GAME’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fffea7d6b581f7d3bd14380ba1e8a484967233f47ceb204bf03832ed93761abb.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**HNBF**".
